info.event: Historical reference: displacement and nutrition response in eastern Chad
info.headline: REFERENCE / TEST: Historical reference: displacement and nutrition response in eastern Chad
info.description: OBSERVATION: In its June 2025 reporting, UNICEF described Sudanese refugee arrivals into eastern Chad and malnutrition treatment needs in Wadi Fira following attacks near El Fasher. INFERENCE: Qualitative publisher summary only. No individual stories, names or health details are copied. Does not establish current displacement, need, funding or service availability.
